newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: P&O, Ausdoc in Australia govt unit buys.
newsitem.headline: P&O, Ausdoc in Australia govt unit buys.

text.p: The Australian government named Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co's Australian unit and a joint venture between Ausdoc Group Ltd and a group of civil servants as preferred buyers for two of its administrative services units.
P&O Australia Services Pty Ltd, a unit of the British shipping and construction group, was earmarked for the sale of maintenance and repair company ASSET Services, the government said on Monday.
Document manager Ausdoc and the staff of domestic freight and storage distributor DAS Distribution were chosen to buy DAS Distribution.
Finance Minister John Fahey and Administrative Services Minister David Jull said in statements that prices would be announced when the contracts were exchanged in a few weeks.
The units are two of six business units to be sold as part of a Department of Administrative Services privatisation plan outlined in the budget in August, 1996.
